mapper.sql:
WITH calculation_source AS ( SELECT t.* FROM
t
WHERE t.${@com.lingan.ucp.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(record.keyColumn)}::text != #{candidateId} UNION ALL SELECT r.* FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::
, CAST(#{candidatePayload} AS jsonb)) r
)

, calculated AS ( SELECT COALESCE(t.${@com.lingan.ucp.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(record.keyColumn)}::text, #{candidateId}) AS calculation_id, (
COALESCE(FIRST_VALUE(t.${@com.lingan.ucp.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(initialColumn)}) OVER calculation_order, 0)
CAST(#{initialValue} AS numeric)
+ SUM(COALESCE(t.${@com.lingan.ucp.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(column)}::numeric, 0)
- COALESCE(t.${@com.lingan.ucp.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(subtractColumn)}::numeric, 0) ) OVER calculation_order)::text AS calculation_value FROM calculation_source t
WINDOW calculation_order AS ( ORDER BY
t.${@com.lingan.ucp.nocode.runtime.dal.support.RuntimeSqlParameters@quote(orderColumn)} ASC NULLS LAST
ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) )
